name: devloop
description: Spec, plan, implement, review: a test-driven development loop for AI coding agents. /spec clarifies what to build and validates the spec. /plan decides how, then runs a plan review and a checkpoint. /implement builds with TDD, then runs a code review (conformance, correctness and cleanup lenses) and a checkpoint, and re-runs the plan review when a finding shows the plan was wrong.

interface.shortDescription: Spec -> plan -> implement TDD loop with independent review gates
interface.longDescription: A test-driven development loop for AI coding agents: /spec clarifies what to build, /plan decides how and gates the plan, /implement builds it with TDD and independent review with conformance, correctness and cleanup lenses. Review agents run in a context that did not write the work.
defaultPrompt: Use /spec to clarify a feature into user stories and acceptance criteria.
Use /plan to decompose the spec into a reviewed chunk plan.
Use /implement to build the plan with TDD and independent review.
